child_list.content: A Story of Nian
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Once upon a time there was a monster named “Nian”. It would attack villages at the end of the year. People had to hide in the mountains. One day, an old man said that Nian was afraid of red and loud noise. So people stick red paper on the doors and windows. At night, Nian came again. People set off the firecrackers. Nian was afraid and ran away.

After that, people pasted Spring Festival couplets and set off firecrackers every Spring Festival Eve. This is the origin of “Chinese New Year”.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

child_list.content: 年兽的故事
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
从前，有个叫“年兽”的怪物，它年底就会袭击村庄。人们不得不躲在山里。一天，一位老人说年兽害怕红色和巨大的响声。于是，人们在门窗上贴上红纸。晚上，年兽又来了。人们放鞭炮。年兽害怕地逃跑了。

此后，每年除夕人们都会贴春联、放鞭炮。这就是中国新年的由来。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
